name: AMC Empty Aware
description: A region frame that notices when the native content inside it has nothing to show, a no-data message, a report table without rows or a card list without cards, and replaces that dead end with a drawn empty state that states what is missing and promotes the region's Create button as the next action, then steps aside when a refresh brings data back.
useFor: Classic Report, Interactive Report, Interactive Grid, Cards and List regions that can legitimately be empty: open requests, filtered searches, documents to upload, exceptions and overdue items on dashboards. Around Forms, Charts and text it is a plain frame.
helpText:
Content-aware region template for regions that can be empty. With the script it checks the region body on load, after apexafterrefresh and whenever the body changes. The region is empty when it has no data rows in any table and no cards in any card list, and it shows an APEX no-data message (Classic Report nodatafound, Interactive Report a-IRR-noDataMsg, Interactive Grid a-GV-noDataMsg, or any element whose class names no data; mark your own with data-amc-no-data), a table with headers but no rows, an empty card list (a list whose class contains Cards or CardView, or one marked data-amc-cards), or no content at all. The no-data message and header-only tables are hidden while the empty state shows and come back on restore; search bars, filters and other controls stay visible so a filtered search can be changed. When nothing native is left the body collapses.

PRINCIPLES APPLIED. Figure-ground: the empty state is the figure, a drawing with a strong outline, a short high-contrast message and one button, on a quiet dotted ground that fades out, so the eye lands on what to do instead of a thin grey line of text. Feedback patterns: the change is announced politely, the empty message on becoming empty and '<region title> updated' when rows return, and the next action is placed at the point of need, never color-only.

THE EMPTY STATE. Message: the Custom Attribute data-amc-empty-title if set, otherwise the text of the region's own no-data message, so the When No Data Found text of a report is reused, otherwise data-amc-text-fallback, Nothing to show. Hint: data-amc-empty-hint, optional, one sentence on why it is empty or what fills it. Action: the button in the region's Create position moves from the header into the empty state and moves back when rows return, keeping focus if it had it; its label, action and authorization stay native. Write the Create label as the action, for example New purchase request.

STRINGS to translate, on the section element in the template or per region as Custom Attributes: data-amc-text-fallback "Nothing to show", data-amc-text-restored "%0 updated" where %0 is the region title; per region data-amc-empty-title and data-amc-empty-hint.

MOTION AND ACCESSIBILITY. The empty state fades in over 0.24s when it appears, and not at all under reduced motion. The drawings are decorative and hidden from assistive technology; forced-colors mode draws them in system colors with a border around the empty state. Without JavaScript the region is a plain frame showing the native no-data message. The native markup is never rewritten; the script only adds and removes the attribute data-amc-empty-hidden. The APEX class names for no-data messages must be confirmed on your release; add data-amc-no-data to a custom message if needed. JavaScript API: amcTplEmptyAware.refresh(element), isEmpty(element) and reload(element).

templateOptions.name: Drawing - Search
templateOptions.help: A magnifier over result lines, for searches and filtered reports where empty means nothing matched. Leave the drawings unticked for the default tray, which suits lists that are simply empty.

templateOptions.name: Drawing - Documents
templateOptions.help: Stacked sheets with a plus badge, for document, attachment and file lists that are filled by uploading.

templateOptions.name: Compact
templateOptions.help: A smaller drawing beside the message in one short row, for dashboard tiles and side columns where a tall empty state would push other content away.

templateOptions.name: Dashed outline
templateOptions.help: A dashed outline instead of the tinted ground marks the empty state as a space to be filled, for upload and drop areas.

templateOptions.name: Frameless
templateOptions.help: No card of its own and no side padding, for regions placed inside another frame such as a dashboard island or a tab.
